# SLA Credit Calculator (SLA Credit Lab)

> Free browser-based calculator that works out the service credit (refund or penalty) owed to a customer when an SLA is missed. It supports a tiered rule (% of the monthly fee by compliance level) or a fixed amount per breached cycle, exclusions and a cap. Everything runs in the browser; nothing is sent anywhere. Published by SLA Credit Lab, which also offers an optional written SLA audit of one contract for €149.

## SLA service credit formula

- counted breaches = breached cycles − excluded cycles
- compliance % = (total cycles − counted breaches) / total cycles × 100 (excluded cycles count as met)
- Per-breach rule: credit = counted breaches × amount per breach
- Tiered rule: credit = monthly fee × tier % / 100, using the lowest threshold the compliance falls below
- Then credit = min(credit, monthly fee × cap % / 100), rounded half-up to the cent
- Example with the default values: 28 − 4 = 24 counted breaches, compliance = 376/400 = 94.00 %, below 95 % → 10 % tier → 1,000.00; cap 20 % = 2,000.00, so the credit is 1,000.00

## FAQ (summary)

- What are service level credits? Same as SLA credits: a contractual fee reduction when agreed service levels are missed, usually a tiered % of the monthly fee or a fixed amount per breach, often with a cap.
- How do I calculate an SLA breach penalty in Jira Service Management? Take met/breached counts from the Jira Service Management SLA report, enter fee, totals, breaches and exclusions into the free calculator, then apply the contract rule and cap.
- Is there a Jira app that calculates SLA credits? SLA Credit Lab for Jira Service Management is submitted to the Atlassian Marketplace. Until it is listed, the free calculator and the €149 written SLA audit are available now.
- What is an SLA credit? A contractual reduction of the fee when the provider misses agreed service levels.
- How is the SLA credit calculated? See the formula above.
- Is my data sent anywhere? No; everything runs in the browser.
- What does the €149 SLA audit include? Written PDF report on one contract's credit clause(s) and one month of SLA results, within 5 business days; arithmetic review, not legal advice.
